title: Technology Sector Update for 07/09/2018: NNDM,PFPT,UMC
text:

Technology stocks were rising ahead of the bell Monday morning.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
+ Nano Dimension ( NNDM ) was soaring in Monday's pre-market, rising nearly 36%, after the three-dimensional printed circuit board manufacturer said it has entered the Chinese market after signing an distribution agreement with Aurora Group. Under terms of the deal, Aurora Group will market and sell Nano Dimension's DragonFly 2020 Pro 3D printer for electronics to Chinese customers.
In other sector news:
= Proofpoint ( PFPT ) early Monday said it hired Klaus Oestermann as its new president and chief operating officer, effective Monday. Oestermann joins the software firm after almost two decades at Citrix Systems ( CTXS ), where he most recently was senior vice president and general manager of its delivery networks division. Proofpoint also said Eric Hahn was retiring as board chairman and will be succeeded by CEO Gary Steele, who is remaining in his current role.
= United Microelectronics ( UMC ) early Monday said its June sales grew 2% over year-ago levels, with the Taiwanese semiconductor wafer foundry reporting NTD13.36 billion in sales, or about $440.2 million, last month compared with NTD13.10 billion in sales during June 2017.
